message_body.subject: Lightweight alternative to heavy LLM routing proxies (<1ms overhead)
message_body.body:
Hi Team,

Saw the recent discussions around multi-model routing complexity and the overhead of managing heavyweight gateway proxies just to handle provider fallbacks and slot selection.

We packaged KIbey Router Harness v1.0.0 (€49, instant download) — a single-file Python module with 0 external dependencies (standard library only) that provides:
- Dynamic slot assignment across fast/frontier models (measured 0.36 µs decision latency)
- Non-blocking OS atomic scope locks (measured 0.51 ms flock acquisition)
- Sub-millisecond failover handling when primary models rate-limit

Delivered as an instant standalone ZIP with passing automated tests and integration guide.

If you'd like the complete package for €49 fixed, reply 'ROUTER' and we'll send the direct download link.

Best regards,
2026-Courier Commercial Engineering
